# Kconfig - fcb configuration options
#
# Copyright (c) 2017 Nordic Semiconductor ASA
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

menuconfig FCB
	bool "Flash Circular Buffer"
	depends on FLASH
	help
	  Flash Circular Buffer (FCB) is a subsystem for managing data in
	  a circular buffer on flash memory.

if FCB

config FCB_CRC8
	bool "Enable CRC8 checksums for FCB entries"
	select CRC
	default y
	help
	  Enable CRC8 checksums for each entry in the FCB. This adds a
	  small overhead but provides data integrity checks.

config FCB_MAX_SECTORS
	int "Maximum number of sectors FCB can use"
	default 16
	help
	  Maximum number of sectors FCB can use. This determines the size of
	  the fcb->f_sectors array.

endif # FCB
